title: Grepo NDJSON stdio protocol
description: Protocol between the Ink UI (Node/Bun) and the Python backend. One JSON message per line (NDJSON). Every message is an object with exactly 'type' and 'value'. UI sends StdinMessage on stdin; backend sends StdoutMessage on stdout. See PROTOCOL.md in this directory for event flow and examples.

StdinMessage.description: Message from UI to backend (stdin). Exactly one of: init, query, set_thinking, cancel.

StdoutMessage.description: Message from backend to UI (stdout). One of: ready, status, delta, done, error, tool_start, tool_result, thinking, cost, interrupt.

InitValue.description: First message from UI. status=true indicates readiness to use this protocol; rootDir is the project directory (cwd) for the backend.

status.description: Must be true. Used instead of a protocol version number.

rootDir.description: Absolute or relative path to the project root (backend uses this as cwd).

ReadyValue.description: Sent by backend after init is processed. status=true means the agent is ready to accept queries.

StatusValue.description: Backend agent state. Sent during and after a run to indicate busy/thinking/compaction.

busy.description: True while the agent is processing a query.

thinking.description: True when extended thinking is enabled.

compaction.description: True when context compaction is in progress.

ToolStartValue.description: Emitted when the agent starts a tool call. name is a short label: list, read, grep, glob, code_search, write.

id.description: Tool call id; links to tool_result with same id.

name.description: Short name: list, read, grep, glob, code_search, write.

data.description: Optional human-readable summary (e.g. path or pattern).

ToolResultValue.description: Emitted when a tool call completes. content shape depends on format.

content.description: String (error/raw) or array of items. Items can be: string; { path, snippet?, root?, line? }; { file, line? }.

format.description: How to interpret content: list_files/read_file/grep/glob (path lists), code (code block), raw/error (string).

CostValue.description: Per-cycle cost and token usage. Sent after a run completes.

InterruptValue.description: Reserved for human-in-the-loop (e.g. edit approval). Not yet sent over stdio.
